alt.zh: 毕棚沟 · 01 摄影作品

copy.en: Glass-calm water mirrors autumn trees and misted ridges. A green-and-white coach sits by the cliff road; a few white cars further in. First snow along the peaks—travel traces small, the mountain large.
copy.zh: 湖面如镜，倒映秋色与雾中山脊。右岸陡壁旁停着一辆绿白巴士，中景有几辆白车。初雪贴着峰线，旅途的痕迹很小，山色很大。

alt.en: Red Maple on Still Water photograph
alt.zh: 红枫映水 摄影作品

copy.en: Among golden larches on the left, one deep red crown; a low brushy islet to the right. Mist and snow on the peaks; water nearly glass. One red note warms the whole cool frame.
copy.zh: 左岸金黄落叶松中夹一棵深红，右侧有矮岛灌丛。峰顶雾雪交叠，湖面几乎无纹。一点红，整幅冷调才有了温度。

alt.en: Red Heart on Snow Shore photograph
alt.zh: 雪岸红心 摄影作品

copy.en: Fresh snow and dry grass in front; still lake and golden conifers mid-frame. A large red heart sculpture on the left shore; colorful walkers scattered. Far peaks in mist—one red note waking the cold.
copy.zh: 前景新雪与枯草，中景静湖与金黄针叶林。岸左一枚大红心形装置，游人彩色衣点散落。远山入雾，一点红把冷场轻轻点醒。

alt.zh: 黄衣行者 摄影作品

copy.en: A thin dirt path crosses the green slope; lower left, a walker in a bright yellow jacket. Rocky peaks and snow behind dissolve into mist under a white sky. That one high note of color sets the mountain’s scale.
copy.zh: 绿坡上一条细土路，左下有穿亮黄外套的行人。后方岩峰与雪线被雾气遮住大半，天色白茫。一点高亮衣色，整幅山才有了尺度。

alt.zh: 雪峰下的湖与路 摄影作品

copy.en: Pale turquoise water fills the foreground, scrub dark along the near shore. A thin meadow sits before rocky peaks patched with snow and piled cumulus. Little wind; the quiet surface and mountain shade make the altitude feel sharp and still.
copy.zh: 湖面呈淡青，近岸灌丛压在暗影里。对岸草甸窄窄一条，再往后是带雪的岩峰与层积云。风不大，水色静，山体的阴影把高处的冷意写得很清楚。

alt.zh: 绿丘望雪峰 摄影作品

copy.en: A broad green hill fills the front, a faint path winding past a few small trees. Left rear, a snow peak brightens; white cloud hugs the mid-slope under clear blue. After grey weather, the mountain suddenly breathes light.
copy.zh: 前景大片绿丘，小路蜿蜒，几棵矮树点缀。左后方雪峰明亮，白云贴着山腰，头顶蓝天开朗。阴天之后的这一口气，山色一下子透亮。
竖构图里，下方是平顶建筑的小聚落，草坡起伏，阳光斑驳。上方岩峰覆厚雪，顶上压着暗云。人影极小，山的体量因此更沉。
copy.en: In a vertical frame, flat-roofed buildings sit in a green fold of hills under broken light. Above, rocky peaks hold heavy snow beneath dark cloud. A tiny figure makes the mountain mass feel absolute.

alt.zh: 雪山下的聚落 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一匹浅白马低头吃草，红缰绳拖在地上。背后是起伏绿丘与覆雪岩峰，厚云压顶。马很小，山很大，安静却不冷清。
copy.en: A pale horse grazes with its head down, a thin red lead trailing on the grass. Rolling green hills lead to snow-capped crags under heavy cloud. Small horse, large mountain—quiet without emptiness.

alt.zh: 白马吃草 摄影作品

title.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge

copy.zh: 草坡斜切画面，坡顶一人牵着红棕马缓行。黄花点在近处草间，大半幅是白亮的低云。人与马只占一线，旅途被缩成一个剪影。
copy.en: A grassy slope cuts diagonally; on the crest a figure leads a reddish-brown horse. Yellow flowers dot the near grass; bright low cloud fills most of the frame. Person and horse become a thin silhouette of the journey.

alt.zh: 牵马过脊 摄影作品
alt.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge photograph

copy.zh: 双车道柏油路呈 S 形爬升，黄线白线清晰，路面有横向减速标线。几辆车疏落地往前开，两侧是绿褐草坡与远山。竖幅把「还要走很久」说得很直白。
copy.en: A two-lane road climbs in an S-curve, yellow and white lines clean, rumble strips across the asphalt. A few cars spaced far apart; green-brown slopes and distant peaks on both sides. The vertical frame says plainly: a long way yet.

alt.zh: 盘山长路 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景暗礁与青苔，一人立在蓝桨板上。对岸红瓦洋房、白圆建筑与摩天轮、玻璃高楼并排。海城交界，像把休闲写进天际线。
copy.en: Dark mossy rocks in front; one figure upright on a blue paddleboard. Across the water: red-tiled villas, a white round building, Ferris wheel, glass towers. Shore and city meeting—leisure written into the skyline.

alt.zh: 桨板与岸线 摄影作品

copy.zh: 俯看港池，红篷白壳小艇排成整齐行列。后方白灰游艇与岸上楼群。深蓝水面映着船体，秩序感干净。
copy.en: From above, red-canopy white boats dock in neat rows. Larger yachts and shore towers behind. Deep blue mirrors the hulls—order kept clean.

alt.zh: 红篷小艇 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景海面飞起一群鸥，岸线绿树与红色螺旋雕塑醒目。玻璃高楼与红顶住宅挤在天际。蓝天干净，像把城市海风写成一张明信片。
copy.en: Gulls lift over teal water; green shore and the red May Wind coil clear. Glass towers and red-roof residences on the skyline. Clean blue—city sea breeze as a postcard.

alt.zh: 五月的风 摄影作品
alt.en: May Wind by the Shore photograph

title.en: Town under Clouds by the Lake

copy.zh: 高处俯看湖湾与沿岸屋舍，白云压在蓝天上。田野与山影交错，光一块暗一块，像风刚吹过云层。
copy.en: From high ground, a lake bay and shoreline houses sit under white clouds on blue. Fields and hills patch light and shade—as if wind just moved the cloud.

alt.zh: 云下湖城 摄影作品
alt.en: Town under Clouds by the Lake photograph

title.en: Light Through Cloud into the Valley

copy.zh: 头顶厚云，山坡沉在冷蓝阴影里。一束软光忽然落到谷底草场与屋舍，把翠绿托亮。路细细绕过村落，像一场短暂的晴。
copy.en: Thick cloud overhead; the slopes stay in cool blue shadow. Soft light falls suddenly on meadows and houses in the valley, lifting the green. A thin road winds past the settlement—a brief spell of clear weather.

alt.zh: 云隙照进谷底 摄影作品
alt.en: Light Through Cloud into the Valley photograph

copy.zh: 高处俯看，深红寺群金顶层层，一处转经亭落在底部中央。山上小红屋密到几乎没有空隙，窄路与一抹蓝车穿行其间。阴天把颜色压得沉稳，不刺眼。
copy.en: From above, crimson temples stack golden roofs; a prayer-wheel pavilion sits at bottom center. Small red houses pack the slope with almost no gaps; a narrow road and a blue truck thread through. Overcast light keeps the colors deep and calm.

alt.zh: 谷中金顶 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一行红袍沿木廊走远，身影略有虚化。右侧金顶与龙形檐饰占住中景，彩绘与木栏细密。背后雪山压在阴云下，暖金与冷山并置，节奏慢。
copy.en: A line of maroon robes walks away along the wooden path, slightly soft with motion. Golden roofs and dragon eaves hold the middle right, painted details and carved rails close by. Snow peaks wait under cloud—warm gold against cold mountain, a slow rhythm.

alt.zh: 红袍远去 摄影作品

copy.zh: 暗红木屋密布山坡，黄栏混凝土阶折线爬升。两名红衣身影走在中段，白灯与电线杆点缀其间。阴天光平，红与黄的对比干净，不喧闹。
copy.en: Dark red wooden houses pack the slope; a concrete stair with yellow rails zigzags upward. Two figures in maroon climb mid-frame; white lamps and poles sit among the roofs. Flat overcast light—red against yellow, clean and quiet.

alt.zh: 黄栏石阶 摄影作品

copy.zh: 天空是淡紫与淡蓝，横云带着浅粉。近处雪峰仍冷，远处那座圆顶山却被金光轻轻盖住。树影与裸岩点缀雪坡，像旅途里短暂的停顿。
copy.en: The sky is pale violet and blue; a band of cloud holds soft pink. Near snow stays cold, while a rounded far peak wears a light of gold. Trees and bare rock punctuate the slopes—a brief pause on the journey.

alt.zh: 晨昏之间 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景一棵苍松，下部犹有针叶，上部枝干已银白裸露。身后是蓝绿相间的山湖，远峰隐在薄云里。树与水对望，时间感比景色更重。
copy.en: A weathered pine stands in front—needles still cling below, while the upper limbs turn bare and silver. Behind it, a turquoise lake and forested ridges fade into soft cloud. Tree and water face each other; time feels heavier than scenery.

alt.zh: 枯枝望湖 摄影作品
alt.en: Weathered Pine Over the Lake photograph

copy.zh: 布满苔藓的枯枝横入画面，阳光在湖蓝水面撒开细碎反光。远岸密林深暗，与近处的亮形成对照。一根旧枝，足够撑起整片闪烁。
copy.en: A lichen-covered bare limb cuts across the frame; sunlight breaks into countless glints on turquoise water. The far bank’s forest stays dark, sharpening the brilliance nearby. One weathered branch is enough to hold the sparkle.

alt.zh: 苔枝与碎光 摄影作品

copy.zh: 浅溪沿暗石台层层跌落，白线细密，苔草贴在岩沿。两岸深绿收得很紧，水声像把整条谷压成一条窄而干净的节奏。
copy.en: A shallow creek spills over dark stone ledges in thin white sheets, moss clinging to each lip. Dense green banks close in, turning the valley into one quiet, measured rhythm.

alt.zh: 阶梯落水 摄影作品

copy.zh: 湿透的红褐石径直伸进林深处，两侧针叶垂得很低。没有行人，只有路面上的天光，静得像一场刚停的雨。
copy.en: A rain-darkened reddish path runs deep into evergreens, needles hanging low. Empty of people, the stones hold only sky-glow—quiet as rain just ended.

alt.zh: 雨后石径 摄影作品

title.en: A Blue Bike on the Autumn Bend

copy.zh: 沥青小径在秋色里转弯，白衣骑手推着一辆青绿单车缓缓前行。金黄枝叶占满画面上方，像把午后轻轻框住。
copy.en: An asphalt path bends through autumn; a rider in white guides a turquoise bike along the curve. Golden foliage fills the upper frame and softens the afternoon.

alt.zh: 秋径上的一辆蓝车 摄影作品
alt.en: A Blue Bike on the Autumn Bend photograph

copy.zh: 前景叶片虚成绿框，运河贴着锈红水杉向前延伸。远处拱桥与行人很小，整条岸线像被季节整齐排过一遍。
copy.en: Blurred leaves frame a canal that runs beside a line of rust-red dawn redwoods. A distant arch bridge and small figures keep the bank orderly and seasonal.

alt.zh: 运河旁的秋列 摄影作品
alt.en: Autumn Line by the Canal photograph

copy.zh: 红褐步道上人影疏落，童帽一抹红。树影横铺路面，黄绿枝叶交叠成廊，午后被慢慢走散。
copy.en: Sparse figures move along a reddish lakeside path, a child’s red hat bright in the light. Tree shadows stripe the ground beneath a yellow-green canopy.

alt.zh: 湖岸秋日闲步 摄影作品

title.en: Round Sun at the Pink-Blue Edge

copy.zh: 正圆太阳贴在薄云上，上方金橙，下方山海沉入粉紫与靛蓝。高处视野把黎明压成一条干净的色带。
copy.en: A round sun sits on thin cloud—gold above, mountains sinking into pink-violet and indigo below. Height reduces dawn to one clean band of color.

alt.zh: 圆日与粉蓝交界 摄影作品
alt.en: Round Sun at the Pink-Blue Edge photograph

copy.zh: 暗云压顶，雪峰一线被橘金点亮，腰间缠着薄雾。冷调山谷衬出那几分钟的暖，像一天里最短的庆典。
copy.en: Dark cloud above, a line of snow peaks lit gold-orange, mist at their waists. Cool valleys frame those few warm minutes like a brief rite of day.

alt.zh: 日照金山 摄影作品

copy.zh: 灰褐高原上，浅水洼旁站着极小的人影。雪峰贴着低云横贯，天空苍白，尺度被风重新量过。
copy.en: Tiny figures stand by a shallow pool on grey-brown highland. Snow ridges run under low cloud; a pale sky recalibrates the scale.

alt.zh: 浅水与雪脊 摄影作品
